instruction_summary: Build the honest 'living version' of Angrist-Krueger (1991): trace the OLS return to schooling (C4) for men 40-49 from 1969/1979 package data to 2024 ACS PUMS (Lane A); re-estimate the IV claims (C3/C1) on the original data with modern weak-IV-robust inference (first-stage F, LIML, Anderson-Rubin sets) (Lane B); and document the death of the QOB instrument via 16-17yo enrollment 1960-2024 (C2, Lane C).

steps.description: Read replication artifacts (logs, verdicts, table4/5/6.json, qob_common.R, the .do files) to reuse the ported pipeline and package estimates
Set up Python venv (pandas, numpy, statsmodels, matplotlib, scipy, requests); R 4.6.1 already present
steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install pandas numpy statsmodels matplotlib requests

steps.description: Lane A+C: download & stream-process ACS 1-Year PUMS 2005-2024 (per-year weighted HC1 OLS educ return, spec i/ii; weighted 16/17yo enrollment shares); process-and-delete each ~500-630MB zip
Fixed 2005-2007 WKW handling (continuous weeks 1-52, not 6-cat intervals) and skipped the non-existent 2020 1-year PUMS (Census COVID gap); re-ran those years
Lane B: OLS/2SLS/LIML/first-stage-F/Anderson-Rubin sets + detrended Q1 education deficit for the three NEW7080 cohorts (FWL residualization, hand-rolled k-class & AR grid)
Confirmed the 1940-49 AR confidence set is empty over [-0.5,0.8] (min AR 3.11 > crit 1.46, over-ID rejected)
SMSA bridge check + assembled tidy estimates_by_window.csv and 3-panel flagship figure and findings.md

comparison_to_original.note: reused as Lane A 1969 anchor; recompute matches
recomputed as Lane B cross-check; matches
IV<->OLS conclusion not sharply identified; 1940s AR set empty

deviations: 2005-2007 ACS WKW is continuous weeks (1-52), not the 6-category interval the instruction assumed (that coding began 2008); verified in-data and used WKW directly, restoring ~181k-record samples for those years.
2020 ACS 1-Year PUMS does not exist (Census released no standard 2020 1-year file due to COVID collection disruption); modern series is 2005-2019 + 2021-2024, with 2024 as the 'now' endpoint.
REGION absent in 2005-2006 ACS; Census region derived from state FIPS (ST).
Panel B uses a year-of-birth x-axis instead of the shared calendar-year axis, because first-stage deficits are a function of birth cohort (1920-1949), which predates the 1960-2025 calendar axis.
Optional CPS ASEC cross-check (section 3.3) not run; Lanes A/B/C completed in full.
LIML, first-stage F, and Anderson-Rubin sets computed by hand (closed-form FWL residualization) rather than linearmodels/ivmodels; validated by exact OLS/TSLS agreement with the replication.
